newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA'S IDC NAMES ACTING CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA'S IDC NAMES ACTING CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER.

text.p: South Africa's state-owned Industrial Development Corp (IDC) has appointed Jan de Bruyn as its acting chief executive officer, its chairman Christo Wiese said on Monday.

Wiese said in a statement that de Bruyn's appointment was an interim measure after managing director Carel van der Merwe's resignation with effect from September 30. The board was still working on the appointment of a new managing director, he said.
The appointment of a permanent chief executive officer would be announced as soon as possible, Wiese said.
